title: Non-constant-time comparison of API tokens enables timing attack
description: auth/tokens.py compares the presented API token to the stored value with a plain '==' in verify_token(). Python string '==' short-circuits on the first differing byte, so response time leaks a prefix oracle and an attacker can recover the token byte by byte over many requests. Use hmac.compare_digest instead. I measured a small but consistent timing difference per matching prefix byte in a local benchmark.
poc_text: Benchmark verify_token() latency across candidate tokens sharing increasing prefixes; matching prefixes are measurably slower.
